name: Pumpkin
author: kubisgg@users.noreply.github.com
description: Minecraft server written in Rust with native Java and experimental Bedrock support. Pumpkin is under heavy development. Expect incomplete features and bugs.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) PUMPKIN_ARCH=X64 ;;
    aarch64|arm64) PUMPKIN_ARCH=ARM64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

GITHUB_PACKAGE="Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin"
VERSION="${PUMPKIN_VERSION}"
MATCH="pumpkin-${PUMPKIN_ARCH}-Linux"
RELEASE_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases"

if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    echo "Fetching latest stable Pumpkin release."
    RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_API}/latest")
else
    echo "Fetching Pumpkin release ${VERSION}."
    RELEASES=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_API}?per_page=100")
    VERSION_CHECK=$(printf '%s' "${RELEASES}" | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name == $VERSION) | .tag_name')
    if [ "${VERSION}" = "${VERSION_CHECK}" ]; then
        RELEASE_JSON=$(printf '%s' "${RELEASES}" | jq -er --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name == $VERSION)')
    else
        echo "Release ${VERSION} not listed. Checking the tag directly."
        RELEASE_TAG=$(printf '%s' "${VERSION}" | jq -sRr @uri)
        RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_API}/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}")
    fi
fi

DOWNLOAD_URL=$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -er --arg MATCH "${MATCH}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $MATCH) | .browser_download_url')
echo "Downloading ${MATCH}."
curl -fSL --retry 3 "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o pumpkin
chmod +x pumpkin

if [ ! -f pumpkin.toml ]; then
    echo "Downloading default pumpkin.toml."
    curl -fSL --retry 3 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/refs/heads/main/minecraft/crossplay/pumpkin/pumpkin.toml" -o pumpkin.toml
else
    echo "Keeping existing pumpkin.toml."
fi

echo "Pumpkin installation completed."

variables.description: Release to download when installing or reinstalling. Use latest for the latest stable release, nightly for development builds, or an exact GitHub release tag. Reinstall to apply a version change.

variables.name: Enable Bedrock
variables.description: Set to true to enable Bedrock, or false to disable it. Restart to apply changes.

variables.name: Bedrock port
variables.description: Port used when Bedrock is enabled. Set this to a separate TCP/UDP allocation assigned to the server. Restart to apply changes.
